materials.applicability: This profile intentionally represents cold-drawn or cold-worked AISI 302/304-family stainless spoke wire for the spoke-body axial model. It is a materials-science reference for the defined material family and condition, not a brand or model certificate.
materials.notes: The elastic modulus, macro-yield reference, and tensile-strength reference are engineering reference points for the defined cold-drawn or cold-worked AISI 302/304-family spoke-wire condition. They are not random placeholders, but they are not universal properties or measured certificates for every spoke brand, model, diameter, or manufacturing batch. The axial elongation calculation uses the elastic modulus; stress ratios and the page safety reference use the macro-yield reference. No separate dislocation-threshold parameter is used by this calculator.
